anchors.note: On the 96th operand, the capacity guard still sees depth 95 and therefore allows the push. After storing that final operand pointer, `parser->top` becomes `parser->stack + 96`, exactly filling the destination buffer from step 1. In the earliest reachable static candidate (Top DICT element 16), that 96th operand is the three-byte token `1c f2 f2`, and the next byte at element offset 101 is operator `0x00` (`version`).

Root cause. The next byte is operator `0x00`, so control leaves the guarded numeric path and enters the operator arm.
